label: Diagram 15.3
caption: Diagram 15.3 Location of firefighting shafts: hose laying distances
description: This drawing shows five floor-plan diagrams, a to e, grouped under 'With sprinklers' (a, b) and 'Without sprinklers' (c, d, e), with 'See para 15.7' above. Green squares F are fire main outlets in firefighting shafts; rectangles are floor plans. a: a square plan, one F, a solid arrow line '60m' to the corner, dotted arcs. b: a rectangle, two F's, overlapping dotted arcs. c: a narrow rectangle, one F, a dashed circle and a dotted circle, arrow lines '45m' and '60m'. d: a rectangle, F and H, a dashed circle and a dotted circle, an arrow line '45m', grey area on the right. e: a rectangle, two F's, two H's, overlapping dotted and dashed arcs, grey central band. The legend reads: dotted line 'Floor plan within 60m hose laying distance of fire main outlet'; dashed line 'Floor plan within 45m hose laying distance of fire main outlet'; arrow 'Hose reach'; F 'Fire main outlet in firefighting shaft'; H 'Dry or wet fire main'; grey 'Additional hose coverage required'. Two notes say the hose laying distance is measured along the laying route, or two-thirds of the direct distance if unknown, and the outlet is located per Section 14.
